continuation_strategy.rationale: The generic guarded workflow has completed production tranches of 25, 50 and 100 records with exact reconciliation and replay protection. T000009 increases only the scientific review tranche size to 200 records while preserving explicit human scientific approval and separately tracked one-use live authorization.

purpose: Define the next generic post-pilot scientific-screening tranche after successful production completion of T000008. T000009 targets 200 records while reusing the already validated generic guard v2 without modification. This design freezes target identity and operational boundaries only; it contains no scientific decisions and grants no live mutation authority.
